tweets.text:
Trading is not for everyone.

It’s ruined some of my sleep. For years.

Sometimes it makes me not want to socialize or go out on big L days. 

There are days I feel like damn I stared at a screen all day, 25 trades deep, only to make a net $5 bucks for the whole day. Makes me question myself.

Trading is not easy.

And if it ever comes to a point where it even remotely jeopardizes the things you love and cherish  most in life, like your friends and family, maybe it’s time to recalibrate your idea of “investing.” 

Not saying quit the stock market, but definitely quit daytrading it. Passive index funds and chill my man.

I wish you well. Family and yourself (and God) above all else.

tweets.text:
Look guys, I think there’s a deep misunderstanding of what stonk’s main token: it’s Zcat, and it’s not even close. 

It’s not Stonk. 

No one gives a shit about launchpads, it’s just their ability to produce runners, and the ceiling they set. The whole stonk run  - both the token itself and the rest of the eco - started there and will end there if they keep vamping themselves with endless copycats, same exact tickers in top 10 even, instead of backing their unique runners directly. 

If the players don’t understand this dynamic and go back to farming bundled unoriginal 2 milli toppers, it’s over.

Long Eco in that sense is vastly superior, and it shows in the raw numbers, in larger mcap, deeper liquidity pools and established pairs. 

That’s their main ability: creating moats around winning teams. Anti vamp measures, ticker protection, in house support. Sacrificing volume and in house revenue short term for a more sustainable long term model.

After an explosive runup, Pons was starting to retrace HARD until Orbi went for a 100 milli run, and they recognized that and BACKED it. Gave their star players like Orbi itself and Index their own pairs and benefits. And it’s now 50% off the lows since and running. More of that. More support, incentives, fostering in house talent.

Base memestonk model will live and die by Vcat. I still stand by that too. In the ability to create a massive runner for their best pair/app/protocol on the market, VVV. 

And creating a moat around it, in fostering their growth.

Again, no one gives a fuck about launchpads. Main runners up immensely is the only way out.
